result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape`, with the same options and behaviour. I compiled the `cli` module offline and its test run passed, but the `cli` module has no tests and I could not run the jar, so the help output and a real `-analysisRoot` run are unverified.

Changes:
- **`cli/.../Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description (landscape counterpart of the analysis commands, same as `updateLandscape`). It is listed in the no-argument usage overview next to `updateLandscape`, with the same landscape options.
- **`cli/.../CommandLineInterface.java`**: the dispatch now routes either name to `updateLandscape(args)`. In the `-help` branch, the usage prints the name the user typed (`args[0]`) and picks the matching description, so `analyzeLandscape -help` and `updateLandscape -help` each print their own usage.
- **`README.md`**: the README had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Command line commands" section covering `analyzeLandscape` and `updateLandscape`.

I did not touch `CLAUDE.md`, which still lists `updateLandscape` among the main commands. Nothing is committed.
